name: mcp-authz-monorepo
description: Authorization for MCP servers: OAuth 2.1 resource server plus a roles/permissions policy

scripts.test:conformance: pnpm --filter mcp-authz exec vitest run src/conformance.test.ts
scripts.verify:python: uv --directory packages/mcp-authz-python run ruff check src tests && uv --directory packages/mcp-authz-python run mypy src tests && uv --directory packages/mcp-authz-python run pytest && uv --directory packages/mcp-authz-python build && pnpm smoke:python-package
scripts.release: pnpm quality && pnpm smoke:npm-package && git diff --exit-code && changeset publish
scripts.quality: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm type-check && pnpm test && pnpm format:check

author: Jag Reehal <jag@jagreehal.com> (https://jagreehal.com)
